subject: Network Theory
questionText:
A y-network has resistance of 10 Ω each in two of its 
arms, while the third arm has a resistance of 11 Ω. In 
the equivalent ∆-network, the lowest value among the 
three is, 
 
(a) 19.09 
(b) 29.09 
 
(c) 33 
(d) 22
explanation: Practice Question from Network Theory DPP-05 (Basic Concept of Network).
